description: Standalone residual ladder for the alpha_EM Bring-zero-mode form (1/a=q[9]_q[10]_q+2g/(4pi(g-1))+a*H*(1-h^2 a)+D2, g=4; H=[2]_q/(8pi), h=q-1/q Hecke structure constant; D2=uncomputed archimedean 2-loop). Integers structurally derived (Bring genus 4; crossing numbers of T_{2,9},T_{3,5}). Honest caveats: (A) conjectural (3 unproved classes), (B) anchor-dependent (~1.7 ppb proton vs ~80 ppb muon; scored at the proton default), (C) proton quadratic ~1.7 ppb = ~11x sigma_a = ~1115x the L2 100x criterion (sigma_a/100 = 0.0015 ppb); SUPERSEDED on the best number by the +Schwinger cubic at -0.365 ppb. Highest-value but long-horizon conjectural close, not near-term. No coefficient fitted; scope-(a).
